map.社交平台分享链接时靠 OG/Twitter 标签渲染卡片。填入页面信息，本工具生: Social platforms rely on OG/Twitter tags to render link cards. Fill in your page details and this tool generates a complete meta snippet — paste it into <head> to improve how your links appear when shared.
map.生成页面头部 meta 与社交分享标签。: Generate head meta tags and social sharing tags.
map.：Open Graph 的 og:title/og:description/og: : Open Graph's og:title/og:description/og:image/og:url, plus Twitter Card's twitter:card and others.
map.：description 控制在 150–160 字符，过长会被搜索结果截断。: : keep the description between 150 and 160 characters; anything longer gets truncated in search results.
map.：viewport 是移动端正确适配的前提，缺失会触发桌面版缩放。: : viewport is a prerequisite for correct mobile rendering; without it, the desktop layout is scaled down.
map.OG 图片建议 1200×630 像素、小于 1MB，过小的图在部分平台不展示大: OG images should be 1200×630 pixels and under 1MB; smaller images do not render as large cards on some platforms.
map.og:type 文章用 article、视频用 video.other；本工具默: For og:type use article for articles and video.other for videos; this tool defaults to website.
map.改完可用社交平台调试器（如 Facebook Sharing Debugger）: After making changes, use a social platform debugger (such as the Facebook Sharing Debugger) to preview how the card is scraped.
map.生成 SEO/社交分享 meta。: Generate SEO and social sharing meta tags.
map.给新页面生成完整 meta：一次产出 title、description 与 o: Generate complete meta for a new page: produce the title, description and og/twitter cards in one go, so that shared links do not end up without a thumbnail after launch.
map.填标题描述 → 输出 `<title>`、description、og:*、tw: Fill in the title and description → outputs `<title>`, description, og:*, twitter:*.
map.og 与 twitter 区别？: What is the difference between og and twitter?
map.og 为 Open Graph（Facebook 等），twitter 为卡片。: og is Open Graph (Facebook and others), while twitter is for Twitter Cards.
map.通常不直接影响排名，但会显著影响点击率——搜索结果里展示的很可能就是这段描述。写: Usually it does not affect ranking directly, but it strongly influences click-through rate — the description is very likely what gets shown in the search results. A specific description that answers the user's intent improves clicks; leaving it blank lets the search engine pull text from the body, which is often less than ideal. Note that descriptions should differ from page to page, since duplicates are treated as a low-quality signal.
